senses.definition: n.pr.m. (meaning dub.; cf. Nab. n.pr. חורו Nö in Eutp. 45)—
𝔊 Ωρ, named with Aaron as compan. of Moses Ex 17:10, 12; 24:14 (all E).
𝔊 Ωρ, a Judahite Ex 31:2 = 35:30, cf. 38:22 (all P) 1 Ch 2:19, 20, 50 (on div. of verse v. Be VB); also 4:1, 4 2 Ch 1:5.
𝔊 Ουρ, a king of Midian Nu 31:8 Jos 13:21 (both P).
𝔊L Σουρ (B om.) head of fam. of returned exiles Ne 3:9.
בֶּן־חוּר officer of Sol. 1 K 4:8, v. sub בֵּן p. 122.
